summary.text: Kristina Roegner is serving her second term in the Ohio Senate for District 27, which includes Portage County and parts of Summit and Geauga counties. She chairs the General Government and Higher Education Committee and is Vice Chair of the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Roegner holds a Bachelor of Science degree in mechanical engineering from Tufts University, graduating cum laude in 1990, and an MBA from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.
Before public office she worked as a management consultant at McKinsey & Company and as a field engineer and project manager for Westinghouse Power Generation Service Division.
She served on Hudson City Council from 2005 to 2010 and four terms in the Ohio House from 2011 to 2018, and the Senate page says she is finishing her final term in the Senate.
She and her husband, Eric, have three daughters and live in Hudson.
